visual_grammar.medium_handling: Cool documentary stills and architectural/contact-sheet fragments overlaid with crisp graphite, blueprint-blue rule lines, plan notation, and measured crop marks.
visual_grammar.composition: Orthographic, gridded, framed, or windowed compositions: floor plans, elevations, organizational charts, façades, and observed behavior held at analytical distance.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Precise ruled edges, hard crop boundaries, architectural line, right angles, and clean figure/ground separation with only small evidence of human hand.
visual_grammar.value_structure: High-key whites and cool grays with disciplined dark linework and sparse accent color; value hierarchy should feel measured and inspectable.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Detached eye-level, elevated, or plan-like views; medium-to-wide framing that places the subject inside a system rather than merging viewer and subject.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: High detail at diagrams, labels, windows, plans, observed gestures, and system boundaries; surrounding fields remain sparse and controlled.
visual_grammar.finish: Taxonomic, architectural, documentary, and cool—the image has been studied before it has been lived.

visual_grammar.medium_handling: Documentary photography broken into repeated frames, flowing contact strips, translucent warm overprints, sound-wave traces, hand-drawn loops, and soft graphite/ink currents.
visual_grammar.composition: Overhead or oblique systems-in-motion: loops, spirals, traffic, crowds, rivers, bicycles, rhythmic repetition, and patterns that can be watched without yet entering them.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Curved traces, repeated contours, soft registration echoes, wave-like boundaries, and partial overlaps rather than hard boxes.
visual_grammar.value_structure: Warm earth and muted documentary mid-values articulated by rhythmic light/dark recurrence rather than a single dominant focal contrast.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Elevated, overhead, or medium-wide observer views that reveal pattern across many moving units; the body is visible as system before it becomes first-person experience.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: Detail repeats in motifs and intervals across the frame—wheels, bodies, waves, marks—rather than clustering entirely around one hero.
visual_grammar.finish: Polyrhythmic, observational, organic, and slightly analytical: flow seen clearly enough to map but not yet surrendered to.

visual_grammar.medium_handling: Bright civic documentary photography mixed with notebooks, interview transcripts, question marks, whiteboard diagrams, poster fragments, colored pencil, and inviting spot-color annotations.
visual_grammar.composition: Open relational fields: two or more people facing, listening, questioning, demonstrating, building, or thinking together across tables, streets, workshops, and public forums.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Open frames, conversational overlaps, hand-marked arrows and circles, porous collage boundaries, and approachable rather than authoritative diagramming.
visual_grammar.value_structure: Clear daylight or bright interiors with optimistic yellows and sky blues balanced by readable documentary neutrals; contrast supports legibility and welcome.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Eye-level human-scale medium views that place the viewer among participants, close enough to read attention and gesture without collapsing into performance close-up.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: Detail gathers at faces, hands, notes, shared tools, public signage, questions, and the actual object of inquiry; background context stays socially legible.
visual_grammar.finish: Civic, dialogic, provisional, and generous—the image feels like an invitation to ask another question and join the work.

visual_grammar.medium_handling: Live-performance and street-documentary frames printed warm and grainy, with motion smear, layered exposures, rhythmic crop sequences, grease-pencil beats, and saturated stage or daylight accents.
visual_grammar.composition: Bodies share the whole field through choreography, bicycle-like circular motion, crossing paths, repeated limbs, and collective groove; the viewer is inside the event, not looking down on it.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Motion-blurred limbs, repeated exposure ghosts, energetic crop edges, sweat-softened light, and gestures that cross or break the frame.
visual_grammar.value_structure: Warm reds, oranges, golds, and electric accents against deep performance dark or bright open daylight; contrast pulses rhythmically across moving bodies.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Close-to-medium body scale, often among the dancers or performers; low/eye-level angles emphasize proprioception, weight shift, feet, hands, and shared space.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: Detail concentrates on bodies in motion, shoes, hands, faces, instruments, sweat, fabric, and the local cues of collective timing; distant context may blur into rhythm.
visual_grammar.finish: Embodied, kinetic, communal, awkward-joyful, and materially live—the frame feels caught from inside a groove rather than composed after the fact.
